title: Meeting processing
description: Transcript hook delivery, automatic ending of inactive meetings, and the default summary profile.
appliesText: A saved change applies within about five minutes.

transcriptHookNonPartialOnly.title: Send only finished segments to the transcript Lambda hook
transcriptHookNonPartialOnly.description: Send only finished segments to the transcript Lambda hook (TranscriptLambdaHookFunctionArn); off adds partial ones.

inactiveMeetingLookbackDays.title: Days to look back for meetings that were never ended
inactiveMeetingLookbackDays.description: How many days back to look for inactive meetings to end; older meetings are never ended automatically.

inactiveMeetingTimeoutMinutes.title: Minutes without speech before a meeting is ended
inactiveMeetingTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes without new transcript before a meeting is ended automatically; 0 never ends it.

defaultSummaryProfile.title: Default summary profile for new meetings
defaultSummaryProfile.description: The summary profile a meeting gets when it starts without one; default uses the Transcript Summary prompts.
